title: Understanding Bernoulli Sampling
text: Bernoulli sampling is a probabilistic method where each row in the table has a fixed probability of being included in the sample. This method can be slower because it evaluates each row individually.

title: Why LIMIT is Faster
text: The LIMIT clause allows the database to stop processing after retrieving a specified number of rows, making it faster than evaluating each row for inclusion as in Bernoulli sampling.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Consider how the database engine processes the LIMIT query compared to the TABLESAMPLE query. Which one requires less computation?
